summary: The community.general hipchat module is deprecated because the service is discontinued, and it will be removed in community.general 11.0.0.
questions: Can I still use the hipchat module?

answer_card.title: hipchat module deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: HipChat is discontinued (the self-hosted version has been EOL since 2020), so `community.general.hipchat` is deprecated and will be removed in community.general 11.0.0.
